why: Iron/Jazzy service introspection publishes each request and response (optionally with contents) as a `service_msgs` `_Event` message on `<service>/_service_event`. Every service and client would need one more publisher, an `_Event` type per service that our codegen does not emit, and a copy of each request/response per call: RAM, a publisher slot per service and wire bandwidth on the targets this API serves, for a host-side debugging view. DECLINED.
